Stack Topology is a Daisy-Chain
Active Topology is a Daisy-Chain
Node MAC Address    Slot  Stack State  Role     Flags
------------------  ----  -----------  -------  ---
*00:04:96:9b:a1:b2  1     Active       Master   CA-
 00:04:96:9b:c3:d4  2     Active       Backup   CA-
* - Indicates this node
Flags:  (C) Candidate for this role, (c) temporarily not a candidate for this role
        (A) Active Node
        (O) node may be in Other stack
